notes: «في حديث عبد الله بن المبارك عن شعبة» is read as Suwayd's book-source for the hadith: Ibn al-Mubarak is the level between Suwayd and Shu'ba; a reading to check against the sources, not a rule-11 case
«عن أبيه» at the end is a bare relation: the Companion's father, not completed
the Prophet's saying follows as «أن النبي ... قال» with no Prophet link
